GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, Restrained & Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 2.5 Lengths 3 Wide turning, Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Fractious in barrier. Raced keenly early stages.] # weakened noticeably

Jumped Ok Restrained from Outside Caught 5 Wide early Soon After let stride Settled Down 3 Wide 4th 3 Lengths Out On A Limb with 1st following , Under Pressure x 400m couldn't finish off - # had no favours

Jumped okay & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, made up a length and a half in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) & Tongue Tie -All- OFF FIRST TIME) # never a factor
Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down almost 1 Lengths Clear off Inside Crossed rail x 600m, Hard Ridden Straightening Up Collared x 200m, couldn't finish off - # led, faded
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary examination of the gelding, which was fractious in the barriers, passed it fit to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 4 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down 2nd last 9 Lengths Not Enough Pace On to assist, 3 Wide x 600m 7 Lengths , had a task 5 Wide Turning for home couldn't finish off Need To See Again - # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Reared as start effected and lost considerable ground. Laid out round home turn. Warning for its barrier manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Not Bustled Quickly Recovered then too keen ! Settled Down 5th 1x1 with cover 2 1/2 Lengths wouldn't settle, out 3 Wide 3rd x 800m 1 Lengths Under Pressure Straightening Up Weakened to the line - # too keen
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, became unbalanced and lost ground. Raced ungenerously in the early and middle stages and approaching the 800m, improved onto heels and shifted out. Warning for its racing manners. Raced wide from the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing a half length, held together much same to turn 1 length Two Wide , hit Lead 240m, went past and kept going to post. (Barrier Blanket ON) # solid win

Little Slow Out Restrained Settled Down 6th 1x1 with cover 3 Lengths following 1st x 2 Lengths to Straightened Up Soon After Outside in Clear , loomed @ 200 just couldn't finish off Sound - # gave 1st 2 leng.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Reared and got its head awkwardly positioned on top of its starting gate, which took a short time to resolve. Raced wide throughout. Laid out when placed under pressure in the home straight. Cast the off fore plate. A post race vet exam revealed no abs. Warning for barrier manners of the gelding.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well off the rails gate settled down fourth bit keen restrained 4 Lengths (800m), travelled strongly took rails run to hit lead early Straight , headed Soon After two horse war, gave plenty however just outgunned (Cross-over Nose Band FIRST TIME, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME) # good debut/gave all
